operations.note: Measured against slack.com on 2026-09-06: the real Web API answers this method over BOTH GET and POST. Every one of the nine write and write-adjacent methods answers `missing_scope` rather than `unknown_method` on both verbs with a read-only token, so the method and the verb are recognised; `chat.getPermalink`, whose scope that token holds, reaches argument validation on both.
